fuelConsumptionMultiplier.description: Diesel and hydrogen helicopter fuel-burn multiplier. 1.0 = default (about 2x a truck of similar cargo). Higher values consume fuel faster; lower values make flying cheaper. Reload the save after changing it. Existing helicopters keep the fuel time already in their tanks; the new setting fully applies after they refuel.

cargoCapacityMultiplier.description: Diesel and hydrogen helicopter cargo capacity multiplier. 1.0 = default (40 / 90 / 180 per tier). Reload the save after changing it. This applies to helicopters built afterward; existing helicopters keep their saved capacity.

buildTimeMultiplier.description: Diesel and hydrogen helicopter assembly time multiplier. 1.0 = default (40 / 55 / 75 s per tier). Higher = slower to build. Reload the save after changing it; assembly already in progress keeps its current timer.

heliportT1PowerKw.description: Power draw of the Open Heliport T1, in kW. Takes effect after reloading the save.

heliportT2PowerKw.description: Power draw of the Open Heliport T2, in kW. Takes effect after reloading the save.

verboseFlightLogs.description: Write detailed per-helicopter flight, yard and cargo handoff diagnostics to the game log. Leave disabled for normal play; enable temporarily when reporting a flight or animation problem. Reload the save after changing it.
